Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.par

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.par
Pushed authorization requests (RFC 9126), opt-in with authserver.par.enabled: the protocol chain customizer that enables the framework's pushed authorization request endpoint.

    ParConfiguration
    Enables pushed authorization requests (RFC 9126) when authserver.par.enabled is true: a client authenticates at POST /oauth2/par, receives a one-time request_uri and then sends the user to the authorization endpoint with it.
